# VulnSchool

> An intentionally vulnerable web application built for security research, penetration testing practice, and learning ethical hacking.

## Links
- [Home](https://vulnschool.onrender.com/): The main landing page.
- [Labs](https://vulnschool.onrender.com/labs): A list of practice vulnerabilities (XSS, SQLi, etc.).
- [About](https://vulnschool.onrender.com/About): About the creator and the project.

## Purpose
This site is a free educational platform for African cybersecurity students.
